evidence: Frozen solution/solve.sh has #!/bin/bash and LF (zero CRLF), copies the static app into /app, only deletes its bounded disposable database/journals, and contains no writes to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution, pkill, NODE_ENV=production or package install. src/db.js reads DB_PATH, has a co-located seed exactly matching the public seed SHA256 1b39015461a7a4f23b835aeea9584caffd0266c64d394778376cbd6c8a18bcf7, and seeds transactionally only when users is empty. src/bootstrap.js independently serves health and binds PORT on 0.0.0.0 before starting the SQLite worker; only installed Express/better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins are needed. Current workbook public-network wording overrides its older internal no-network/no-runtime-install annotation. Actual indexed install-lifecycle evidence (results SHA256 368261834b06931f2e8ac0fa0fd909a435e7ae28a6c30444c3ff48240d27bb24; driver 05780ac5eb6f1e441ef5a946a36f466ad7cdee7ae239b5f7d7d9f5933f39e024) shows fresh install, sanitized unprivileged startup, normal shared MCP replacement PID 21 to 97 retaining a saved record, and closed-workspace reinstall restoring 7 requisitions/13 offers. Active reinstall refusal was EACCES while inspecting /proc, so it proves fail-closed preservation, not successful identification of the exact open SQLite descriptor. All cited indexed hashes, all 37 source bindings and all 13 solution app hashes were independently recomputed; generated restart helper exactly matches the frozen heredoc after substitutions. Fresh isolated Docker execution of evidence/19/runtime_probe.py using the verifier image and read-only frozen solution passed bash -n and exact file-copy assertions, launched node /app/server.js from /tests with env -i/setpriv UID 65534, PORT=3191 and DB_PATH=/tmp/row19-db/overridden.sqlite, authenticated and saved a new record, confirmed /app/app.db absent, then restarted and retained that exact record with counts 8/13 (no duplicate seed). Probe driver SHA256 c7bdfe4b611a6dcd8bee0b7b699cb10947ee68f71f89450a823c6a9f041a8c40; raw result SHA256 ea7f1b7dc0e0174f111ec813642aa344fcd7119a4b58e0d32452b639f83854b4. Adversarial reasoning: a seed-only/in-memory app could satisfy HTTP health and first paint, but cannot satisfy the saved-record restart witness; a valid app using a different database location or nondefault PORT must remain accepted, directly exercised here. This row does not establish configured grading, an Oracle/model score, or adversarial shared-harness restart safety.
